footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.1% to $6.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 68.0%, versus 69.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 20.9% to $794M, a 12.9% margin.
Net income rose 51.7% to $625M, or $0.72 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.3B and free cash flow $852M, versus $606M; Smith & Nephew returned $832M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Smith & Nephew plc Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
